en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘When an immoral woman is asked, ‘Who has been immoral with you?’, so she says, ‘So and so’, so upon her would be two Penalties – a Penalty (Hadd) for her immorality, and a Penalty (Hadd) for her accusation upon the Muslim man’.
